result.brief: 提出四张量注意力更新，联合归一化语义与时间上下文纤维以预测场景下一语义状态，声称用于视频生成与机器人规划，但仅在文本故事数据上验证。
result.reason: Proposes a 4-tensor attention update predicting next semantic state for video generation and robot planning, but tests only on text (ROCStories); no visual/video representation or world-model experiments shown.
